gui.waypoints_vanillafied.name: name
waypoints_vanillafied.config.title: Waypoints Vanillafied Config
waypoints_vanillafied.config.hide_locato: Hides the vanilla locator bar background and makes the Experience bar take priority over it.
waypoints_vanillafied.config.create_deat: Whether death points are automatically created when you die.
waypoints_vanillafied.config.death_point: How many minutes a death point stays on the locator bar before it is deleted automatically. Set to 0 to keep death points until you reach them.
waypoints_vanillafied.config.tooltip_mod: Controls when the waypoint name/distance tooltip is shown above the locator bar.
waypoints_vanillafied.config.show_pitch_: Whether pitch arrows are rendered above/below the waypoint icons.
